section_path: CERVICAL LYMPH NODES AND UNKNOWN PRIMARY TUMORS OF HEAD AND NECK
text: Codes 0, 1, 2, and 4 are not applicable for this chapter.

section_path: CERVICAL LYMPH NODES AND UNKNOWN PRIMARY TUMORS OF HEAD AND NECK
text:
This chapter applies when cervical lymph nodes are involved with cancer and the primary site is not known but is suspected to be in the head and neck, i.e., in one or more of the sites listed below. Cancer registry standard setters have agreed that such cancers should be coded to primary site code C760 to accommodate staging recommended by AJCC.

Lip: C003-C005, C008-C009
Base of Tongue: C019
Other and Unspecified Parts of Tongue: C020-C024, C028, C029
Gum: C030-C031, C039
Floor of Mouth: C040-C041, C048-C049
Palate: C050-C052, C058-C059
Other and Unspecified Parts of Mouth: C060-C062, C068-C069
Parotid gland: C079
Major Salivary Glands: C080-C81, C088-C089
Tonsil: C090-C91, C098-C099
Oropharynx: C100-C104, C108-C109
Nasopharynx: C110-C113, C118-C119
Pyriform sin: C129
Hypopharynx: C130-C132. C138-C139
Other and Ill-defined Sites in Lip, Oral Cavity and Pharynx: C140, C142, C148
Nasal cavity: C300
Middle ear: C301
Accessory Sinuses: C310-C313, C318-C319
Larynx: C320-C323, C328-C329
Skin of lip: C440
Skin of ear & external auricular canal: C442
Skin of other & unspecified parts of face: C443
Skin of scalp & neck: C444

section_path: CERVICAL LYMPH NODES AND UNKNOWN PRIMARY TUMORS OF HEAD AND NECK
text: If the physician indicates that the metastatic cervical lymph node is most likely from a head and neck primary, then code primary site as C760.

section_path: CERVICAL LYMPH NODES AND UNKNOWN PRIMARY TUMORS OF HEAD AND NECK
text: If the differential diagnosis includes non-head and neck sites, for example, the path report states metastasis to the cervical lymph node could be from a head and neck primary, lung primary, or gynecologic primary OR if there is no information indicating origin of primary tumor, then code primary site as C809 (Ill Defined Other)
